1.o: في عام 2012، يعيد محققو شرطة ولاية لويزيانا راست كوهل ومارتن هارت زيارة قضية قتل عملوا عليها في عام 1995. مع تطور التحقيق في الوقت الحاضر من خلال استجوابات منفصلة، يسرد المحققان السابقان قصة تحقيقهما، مع إعادة فتح جروح لم تشف. يثير القصة التساؤل حول حلاهما المفترض لقضية قتل غريبة تشمل طقوسًا في عام 1995. ولكن مع التحقيق الأصلي الذي يتطور، يكتشف التحقيق الجديد أدلة جديدة تشير إلى وجود شيء أكثر خبثًا مما كان أي شخص قد تخيله.

2.o: تحت الضغط للقبض على مشتبه به في جريمة قتل لانج، يحذر كويسادا هارت وكوهل أنهم قد يتم استبدالهم بثلاثة محققين من فريق عمل جديد. يتقدم الثنائي للحصول على وقت إضافي لمتابعة تحقيق يأخذهما من بيت دعارة ريفي إلى كنيسة محترقة. مع تدهور حياته الشخصية بالفعل بسبب العمل، يجد هارت استراحة بعيدًا عن المنزل.

3.o: يتبع هارت وكوهل سلسلة من الأدلة من أجل تعقب المشتبه بهما الرئيسي.

4.o: يبحث هارت وكوهل عن المشتبه بهما المعرفين حديثًا، ريجي ليدو، صانع الميث الذي قاسم زنزانة زوج ضحية قتل دورا لانج وتخطت عليه مؤخرًا الإفراج المشروط. مع تدهور حياة هارت الشخصية حوله، ينغمس كوهل في هوية إجرامية قديمة من أيام ناركو، حيث يتصل بعصابة دراجين من شرق تكساس يُعرف أنهم يتعاملون مع المشتبه بهما الرئيسي.

5.t: The Secret Fate of All Life
5.o: يتقاسم هارت وكوهل غنائم القضية المحلولة؛ بابانيا وجيلبو تواجهان المحققين بمعلومات جديدة مزعجة.

6.o: يتبع هارت وكوهل سلسلة من الأدلة في محاولة لتعقب المشتبه بهما الرئيسي.

7.o: يبرم هارت وكوهل هدنة لاستقصاء سلسلة غامضة من حالات الاختفاء المرتبطة بتعبيرات قتل دورا لانج وعائلة توتل. تُلاحظ ليزا زوجة هار

8.o: تُقدّم تفاصيل تم تجاهلها لهارت وكوهل خيطاً جديداً مهماً في قضيتهما التي استمرت 17 عاماً

1.t: The Western Book of the Dead
1.o: تجمع جريمة قتل غريبة ثلاثة من رجال الشرطة ومجرمًا محترفًا في مدينة فينشي الفاسدة بكاليفورنيا.

2.o: يُكلّف راي وآني وبول بقضية قتل كاسبير، فيما يحاول فرانك الإبقاء على صفقاته رغم وفاة كاسبير.

3.o: يتابع بول خيطًا مرتبطًا بالدعارة، فيما تسقط الضحية الأولى في حرب فرانك السرية.

4.o: يقود خيط من متجر رهونات فريق التحقيق إلى مشتبه به في قضية كاسبير، فيما يعود فرانك إلى ماضيه لتسوية حسابات الحاضر.

5.o: يفكر راي وفرانك في خيارات جديدة لحياتهما، فيما يتجه آني وبول إلى الساحل لمتابعة خيط في القضية.

6.o: في سباق للعثور على امرأة مفقودة تملك معلومات عن كاسبير، يلتقي فرانك تجار مخدرات مكسيكيين. وتتسلل آني إلى دائرة نخبوية، ويراقب راي وبول تحركاتها.

7.o: يقترب آني وبول وراي من كشف حقيقة كاسبير، لكن الخطر يحيط بهم وبمن حولهم. ويواجه فرانك خيانة من داخل دائرته، ويحصل على معلومات مهمة قبل أن يحدد خطوته التالية.

8.o: يحاول راي وآني النجاة من مأزقهما، فيما يعمل فرانك على تسوية ما تبقى من أموره.

1.t: The Great War and Modern Memory
1.o: يؤدي اختفاء شقيق وشقيقة صغيرين إلى عملية بحث محمومة ستلازم أحد المحققين بقية حياته.

2.o: مع استمرار البحث عن جولي، تثير الدمية التي عُثر عليها في مسرح الجريمة رد فعل، فيما يعثر واين ورولاند على مشتبه به محتمل.

3.o: يعود واين وأميليا إلى التواصل مع استمرار البحث عن جولي، ويعيد واين ورولاند تتبع التحقيق بحثًا عن خيوط فاتتهما. وفي وايت فينغر، يتلقى أحد السكان تحذيرًا.

4.o: يتقصى واين ورولاند صلات محتملة بين الكنيسة المحلية وقضية آل بيرسل، فيما تتصاعد التوترات في وايت فينغر.

5.o: في عام 1980، تتصاعد الأحداث في منزل وودارد، وفي الحاضر يستعيد واين ورولاند التواصل بعد اكتشاف جديد.

6.o: في عام 1990، يعيد واين ورولاند فتح ملف بيرسل لكشف خيوط أخفيت أو نُسيت، فيما يبحث توم عن إجابات وتعود شخصيتان من الماضي.

7.o: بعد العثور على ما يبدو أنه انتحار عام 1990، تُعلن قضية بيرسل محلولة. لكن واين ورولاند لا يقتنعان بذلك، ويقودهما اعتراضهما إلى خطوة حاسمة.

8.o: يصعب على واين الحفاظ على ذكرياته وصلته بالواقع، فيما تنكشف أخيرًا حقيقة قضية بيرسل.

1.o: تختفي مجموعة من الرجال العاملين بمحطة أبحاث تسالال القطبية في بلدة إينيس بألاسكا. ولحل القضية، تواجه الرئيسة ليز دانفرز وإيفانجلين نافارو ظلامًا وأسرارًا دفنتها طبقات الجليد الأبدي.

2.o: حين يهدد كونولي بنقل قضية تسالال إلى أنكوريج، تكتشف نافارو ودانفرز خيطًا جديدًا يقربهما مجددًا بعد سنوات من التباعد.

3.o: بينما يبحث الفريق عن كلارك، يستفسر برايور من دانفرز عن القضية التي أضعفت شراكتها مع نافارو. ويقود تفتيش مقطورة كلارك إلى خيط عن عامل آخر في تسالال، فيما تحتدم الخلافات بين دانفرز وابنة زوجها.

4.o: ترافق نافارو جوليا إلى مركز محلي بعدما عادت أزمتها الصحية، وتعدها بالمساعدة. وتعثر دانفرز ونافارو على موقع مقتل آني، فيما تتوتر علاقة دانفرز بابنة زوجها ليّا على خلفية احتجاجها.

5.o: يحقق الفريق في صلات بين تسالال ومنجم سيلفر سكاي، وتنقذ نافارو ليّا من احتجاج ينقلب إلى العنف. وتحذر كيت ماكيتريك دانفرز من مواصلة التحقيق.

6.o: في إينيس بألاسكا، يختفي الرجال الثمانية الذين يديرون محطة تسالال للأبحاث القطبية بلا أثر. وتحاول المحققتان ليز دانفرز وإيفانجلين نافارو حل اللغز ومواجهة ما تخفيانه من ظلمة في داخلهما.

1.o: Kakeru Aizawa is the manager for his middle school soccer team and younger brother to soccer prodigy Suguru Aizawa. His childhood friend, Nana Mishima, returns from America and enrolls into his class. That night, Kakero secretly practices soccer at the park and is challenged to a match by a masked stranger. The next day, Suguru has Kakeru enter a soccer match for the chance to join the regulars as a forward.

2.o: Kakeru displays his skills as a forward by predicting and receiving Suguru's skilled passes. Whenever Kakeru has a chance to score, he changes his footing and hits the ball with his right leg reducing the power of the shot and prevents him from scoring. That night, Kakeru meets the masked stranger and explains how he injured a classmate with his left leg during a soccer match which is the cause to his playing style. That morning on the way to school, Suguru attempts to tell Kakeru he is the only forward able to receive his passes. In the middle of the conversation, they are hit by a truck.

3.o: In the coma, Kakeru relives the day he, along with Suguru and Nana, promise to join Japan's national soccer team. Meanwhile, Suguru is pronounced brain dead and his family agree to the hospital's decision to transplant his heart into Kakeru to save his life; Nana happens to overhear the decision. After several days, Kakeru is discharged from the hospital and resigns from the soccer team. At the park, a girl is almost hit by a car but is saved when Kakeru kicks a ball and stops the driver.

4.o: Kakeru is unable to recall what happened when he kicked the ball, leading Nana to suspect Suguru's heart is the cause. At the hospital, Suguru's sport counselor, Ayaka Mine, examines Kakeru and reminds him to exercise for his heart. She secretly tasks Nana to watch for Suguru-like behavior from Kakeru possibly resulted from the transplant. That night, Kakeru learns that the masked stranger is Nana and that he received a heart transplant from Suguru. As Kakeru reads through Suguru's dairy, he discovers his brother's frustration with the forwards in Japan's national team and how he desires Kaker

5.o: A year passes and Kakeru and Nana are now students in Enoshima High school. They enroll in a soccer club, discovering that their club is the school's unofficial soccer team dubbed FC. They learn that before nationals tournament, FC competes with the official soccer team, dubbed SC, to determine who represents the school. Kakeru and Nana remain on the team after realizing FC's unconventional training is more effective than SC's. Meanwhile, Kakeru attempts to persuade Ryuichi to rejoin FC, who quit soccer and become overweight after losing to SC. Ryuichi explains the same frustration he felt as

6.o: The match between FC and SC to decide who will represent the school for nationals begins. Ryuichi fails to show up during the match and the team plays without him. After the first half, SC leads by two points. A player on FC is injured and is forced to stop playing. Kota Nakatsuka, Kakeru's middle school friend, quits the SC team and joins the FC team to sub for the player. The game resumes and Kakeru scores a goal as does SC ending the second half with 1:3 lead by SC. Ryuichi, having lost weight, joins FC and subs in for a player for the final half of the game.

Asuka begins marking Kakeru and forces him to turn the ball over. The ball is passed to Haruki Onimaru who dribbles to Enoshima's corner. 34.t: Raise the Curtain! High School Championship

1.o: When Anthony’s school project gets him in trouble with his teacher, it creates tension between Luke and Henry and the rest of the family. After Henry sends Anthony on a scavenger hunt for his 10th birthday, Helen and Luke panic when their son mysteriously vanishes.

2.o: Cautiously hopeful when a witness comes forward with information about Anthony, Luke and Helen set off on their own to search for their son while Henry becomes obsessed about an item Anthony left behind.

3.o: Luke continues to look for a connection between his son’s disappearance and his father’s old case files while Helen is prepared to do whatever necessary to get information that could reunite her with Anthony. Despite Susan’s warning about working against her investigation, Henry continues his own search for answers.

4.o: Susan and Charles focus their investigation on Stephen Price – their main suspect in Anthony’s disappearance. Still driven to pursue his own investigation but confined to a hospital bed, Henry confides in Fred, Catherine’s patient.

5.o: Henry asks Fred for help in decoding the clues left by Anthony’s abductor. Luke and Helen still believe their son's disappearance is related to Henry's past. Susan makes an important discovery and issues an Amber Alert.

6.o: The police and the Sullivans race to find Anthony.

1.o: Once childhood sweethearts, high school seniors Chiyomi and Shunichi have drifted apart. One day, she realizes she still has feelings for him.

2.o: Wishing she were little again, Chiyomi is transformed into a miniature version of herself. When Shunichi finds her, she begs him to keep her hidden.

3.o: Shunichi takes Chiyomi shopping. They sneak into a local shrine where a legendary sacred mallet may be the key to solving her "tiny" problem.

4.o: Shunichi's mother and Chiyomi talk him into rejoining the kendo team for an important match. Meanwhile, a suspicious man snoops around his household.

5.o: Chiyomi sneaks out to get some doll dresses from her house. When she returns to Shunichi's home, she finds a mysterious couple who might be burglars.

6.t: I Know I'm Not Good Enough
6.o: Chiyomi secretly attends school but is seen by Riku. Later, Sayori stays over at Shunichi's house and sneaks into his room that night for a kiss.

7.o: Chiyomi is discovered by Shunichi's grandmother, who thinks she's a legendary princess. Later, she tries to fix a marital problem between her parents.

8.o: Tomiko is hospitalized after she suddenly faints. Shunichi is relieved to hear she's OK but soon has cause for worry when Chiyomi goes missing.

9.o: After questioning Shunichi, Riku finds out the truth about Chiyomi. Shunichi and Chiyomi leave on a trip to a hot springs to turn her back to normal.

10.o: Shunichi and Chiyomi eagerly await the legendary sunrise at Cape Akebono. Later, on the way home, Shunichi is hit by a car and hospitalized.

1.o: Wayne, a 16 year-old Dirty Harry with a heart of gold, sets out on his dirt-bike from Boston to Florida with his new crush Del, to get back a s*** hot '79 Trans Am that was stolen from his father before he died.

2.o: When Wayne fails to do one simple task for Del, she questions her choice to leave Brockton. The consequences of this small failure have life-threatening results when Wayne crosses paths with a dangerous local.

3.t: Chapter Three: The Goddamned Beacon of Truth
3.o: After Wayne and Del make an appearance on the local news, Del gives Wayne a lesson in lying in order to keep their new cool friends at bay. But it’s not long before their lies are discovered and their cover is blown.

4.t: Chapter Four: Find Something Black to Wear
4.o: After being robbed, Wayne goes to work as a day laborer as Del becomes obsessed with a stranger’s death. Meanwhile, Carl and Teddy celebrate their birthday on the road and come to terms with who their father really is.

5.o: A look back on a day long before Wayne met Del; a day that changed Del, Daddy, and the boys forever.

6.t: Chapter Six: Who Even Are We Now?
6.o: When Del makes friends at a local Georgia high school, Wayne worries she might miss home. Or even worse--that she may want to stay and live the life she never had in Brockton. Meanwhile, Daddy and the boys are closing in fast, and Orlando helps Cole with a speech for the Principals Conference.

7.o: Wayne struggles with whether or not to tell Del that her dad is in the hospital, while Sergeant Geller lays a trap for Wayne and Del.

8.t: Chapter Eight: Musta Burned Like Hell
8.o: After their first kiss, Wayne and Del arrive in Florida, where they have a chance encounter with the elusive Trans Am. But when Wayne reconnects with his mom Maureen, Del starts to realize Wayne’s real reason for coming to Florida might not be the car after all.

9.t: Chapter Nine: Thought We Was Friends
9.o: When things with both Del and his mom go south, Wayne turns this attention back to his dad’s Trans Am. But he has to contend with Calvin and Reggie to get it. Meanwhile, Del learns a secret about Wayne that changes everything for her.

10.t: Chapter Ten: Buckle the F**k Up
10.o: Wayne, now under arrest and on his own, must face off against Reggie in a brutal fight to settle their rivalry. Meanwhile, Del returns to Wayne’s mom’s house, determined to get her man back by any means necessary.

1.t: The Flash of Lightning Before It Thunders
1.o: Unlike her friends, Kim Jojo has more pressing things on her mind than dating. Upon returning from abroad, Hwang Sun-oh goes to see Lee Hye-yeong.

2.t: There’s Nothing Anyone Can Do When You Like Someone
2.o: Sun-oh wants to know whether Hye-yeong has feelings for Jojo and tells him what he did. Jang Il-sik gets into a fight with Sun-oh and Hye-yeong.

3.t: The Miracle of Two People Liking Each Other
3.o: Jojo confronts Sun-oh about the photos. As rumors spread at school, Jang-go gets mad at Jojo for lying. Il-sik confronts Jang-go about what she did.

4.t: The Best Feeling in the World Is Knowing There’s Someone on My Side
4.o: Sun-oh asks Jojo about the school trip and realizes there’s not much he can do for her. Il-sik tells Jang-go something she doesn’t want to hear.

5.o: Jojo tells Sun-oh about her parents and makes a surprising suggestion. She later confronts Jang-go after overhearing something.

6.o: News of the tragedy hits the airwaves. Hye-yeong finds Jojo at the library and informs her that he plans to court her the old-fashioned way.

7.t: Something I’ve Been Holding Back and Can Only Say to You
7.o: Jojo tries to put a shield around herself and tells Hye-yeong she doesn’t need his help, but he offers to take her somewhere special.

8.t: One Is Bigger Than Any Other Number in the World
8.o: Jojo ponders what it means to like someone and realizes a shield may not be necessary. Sun-oh wants to know whether she still has feelings for him.

1.o: Curious about her true feelings for Hye-yeong, Jojo returns to her alma mater in search of information on Chon Duk-gu — and runs into her past.

2.o: Jojo asks Brian Chon about the shield at an event attended by the Badge Club members, including Sun-oh. Hye-yeong comes face-to-face with his father.

3.o: Jojo offers Hye-yeong a shoulder to cry on after a punishing day. Unable to cope with knowledge of the shield, Sun-oh turns to Jojo for the truth.

4.o: With video of his lecture hall visit gone viral, Sun-oh comes to blows with Hye-yeong. Jojo receives a special gift from an unknown sender.

5.o: Park Gul-mi reaches a digital milestone. Brian grills Jojo about the shield, spear and Duk-gu — and shatters reality for a bystanding listener.

6.o: Revealing the identity and inspiration behind The Ringing World, Jojo reconciles with the past. Duk-gu keeps his end of the bargain.

1.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels by motorbike through Peru's Sacred Valley of the Incas to discover traditional high-altitude cuisine. Immersing himself in local culture, he scales cliffs, fishes in high-altitude lakes, and samples local delicacies like fried worms, rare multicolored potatoes and guinea pig before putting his newfound skills to the test with legendary local chef Virgilio Martinez.

2.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay journeys to the remote corners of southern New Zealand to unlock the secrets of traditional Maori cuisine. From the locals, he learns how to catch eels with his bare hands, free dives for prized Paua shellfish and forages for unique Kiwi ingredients before putting his new skills to the test at a Maori feast with up-and-coming chef Monique Fiso.

3.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to Morocco, North Africa, where he embarks on an adventure deep in the Middle Atlas Mountains to understand ancient Berber cuisine. Learning from the locals, he rappels over a waterfall to meet mushroom hunters, milks a camel and experiences the life of the Berber people. He puts his new skills to the test, cooking a feast with chef Najat Kaanache to celebrate Berber New Year.

4.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to Maui, Hawaii, to explore the exotic ingredients of Hawaiian cuisine. In torrential rain, he travels along the treacherous Hana Highway. From the locals, he learns how to hunt deer with a bow, produce Hawaiian taro and spearfish with legendary free diver Kimi Werner. Gordon tests his knowledge at a feast with top Hawaiian chef Sheldon Simeon.

5.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay travels to Laos, where he takes on a rapid stretch of white water, kayaking down the Mekong in search of culinary inspiration. Learning from the locals, he treks through dense jungle to sample eggs of the aggressive weaver ant, dives for freshwater snails and hunts for giant water bugs. Using his newly acquired skills, he cooks a banquet for monks at the local temple.

6.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay journeys to the rugged Alaskan Panhandle to learn survival skills and discover Alaskan cuisine. On his adventure, he learns how to cook seal with a native Tlingit elder, climbs a sheer rock face in a snowstorm and goes grouse hunting before putting his newfound knowledge to the test at a feast with legendary local chef Lionel Uddipa.

1.o: Chef Ramsay explores Tasmania, off the coast of southern Australia. He discovers the purity of the island, diving into shark-infested waters for giant saltwater spiny lobsters, and avoiding venomous snakes in the bush while foraging for local herbs.

2.o: Chef Ramsay gets up close with rhinos, giraffes, zebras and hippos in the dramatic wilderness of KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, as he learns the secrets of the traditional cuisine of Zulu warriors and masters using a local braai.

3.o: Chef Ramsay journeys to Louisiana to learn the secrets of Cajun cooking. He meets Eric Cook, a former Marine turned celebrated chef who sends him off to get lost in the marsh and see what he brings back.

4.o: Chef Gordon Ramsay's quest to master the world's most fascinating cuisines lands him on the Indonesian island of Sumatra, where he risks his safety and his pride to acquire the ingredients he needs.

5.o: In the Amazon Basin, Gordon finds a wealth of opportunities to create his spin on traditional Guyanese cuisine.

6.o: In the spice capital of the world, Gordon learns to master the complex culinary layers of the region.

7.o: From herding reindeer to scuba diving in wintry waters, Gordon gets to the heart of traditional Norwegian cuisine and where it’s headed.

2.o: Bloom has a dream where she finds Annabelle in a forest. When they are called by Wow! to find another talent, the Winx split into two groups: Bloom, Flora and Tecna pretend to be sick so they can search for Annabelle, while Stella and Aisha have Musa dress up as their upcoming talent for their Wow! episode. 3.t: The Legend of the Crocodile Man
3.o: The Winx's next appearance on Wow! is interrupted by a report from New York City in which a crocodile monster (Crocodile Man) has been spotted near on a boat. Flora senses that a guy named Naoki is connected to this so the Winx girls head to Manhattan to find Naoki, who tries to escape from the girls but then finds himself being pursued by Crocodile Man. The Winx save Naoki and reveal to him that they are fairies.

4.o: The Winx have found a pocket watch that was dropped by Crocodile Man. They and Naoki try to capture Crocodile Man, but the latter proves to be very strong and elusive. The Winx discover that Crocodile Man is more interested in going after the watch than Naoki. Although Crocodile Man gets the watch and escapes through a portal, Tecna has placed a tracker inside that watch and they learn that Crococile Man has escaped into the World of Dreams.

5.o: Bloom contacts Annabelle and learns that she had found a similar pocket watch dropped by a guy who had broken into her apartment and then escaped. The Winx head to Paris to recruit a fashion design student named Sophie. Sophie is reluctant to join and dislikes Stella's style, so Stella suggests they have a contest to see who has the better style. During the contest, Stella encourages Sophie to design the dress of her dreams. Sophie is invited to have the Winx model her new design at a show. Crocodile Man kidnaps Sophie. Although they defeat Crocodile Man and rescue Sophie, they discover she is

6.o: The Winx sneak into an exclusive fashion week party to look for the Sophie imposter. Bloom discovers the imposter is a shadow creature, but accidentally falls onto the party's cake, causing much embarrassment. The Winx return to the Paris fashion academy where they recruit office worker Nadine to try becoming a model. Nadine is invited by the fake Sophie to model, but the Winx confront Sophie and a bodyguard at the Eiffel Tower. As punishment for ditching the show, Ace has the Winx girls perform some activities that are not within their natural talents. Although Bloom surprises everyone with h

7.o: Ace sends a new girl named Lorelei to replace Bloom as a talent scout on the show. The Winx find their next talent prospect, an apprentice chef named Vincenzo who has been trying to make his own creations but refuses to listen to his boss Tony or anyone else for advice. The Winx pair up with each of the participants in the competition as their assistants, and eventually encourage and guide Tony to make the right kind of food that he has been dreaming of. 1.o: The series premiere introduces the hard-partying Dr. William P. Rush as he navigates his job doing discreet freelance work for society's elite after losing his job as an ER doctor. However, Rush must navigate his rocky relationship with his father all while chaperoning a troubled actor back to set after he jeopardizes his last-chance comeback.

4.o: Rush and his stepmother go to lunch, leading to an unexpected outcome. Alex’s marriage is strained because of his relationship with Rush. 5.o: In order to avoid anxiety, Rush takes on any medical call he gets; Eve discovers her value.

1.o: We meet John and Anne Darwin, a couple plagued by debt. Facing bankruptcy John decides to fake his own death using his canoe, much to the horror of his wife. They successfully pull it off and John goes into hiding while Anne consoles her sons.

1.o: Dali Delico is an aristocratic vampire who's been neglecting his duties at work. When some of his associates visit him one day to confront him about it, however, they find him taking care of a small child...

2.o: In exchange for agreeing to accept the case, Dali demands that the investigators establish their base of operations in his nursery, forcing them to help with both the mission and child-rearing.

4.o: Dali's son Raphael has entered his long-dreaded rebellious phase. Envious of the attention Dali is lavishing on his younger son, Ul, Raphael jealously wishes for his little brother's death...

5.o: Wary of potential Pendulum strike on the Delico residence, the men send the children to stay with Clara, the Delico nanny. But something strange is happening to the oldest child, Theodore...

6.o: Clara and the others are baffled by young Theodore showing signs of entering his cocoon phase at such an early age. Meanwhile, the other children take Ul with them for a little adventure outside the manor.

7.o: Dali and company go to retrieve the children from their little adventure, but they may end up having to fight harder than expected to get their kids back...

8.o: After he deduces that the bandaged member of Pendulum, Juras, is a survivor of Nebula Village, Dali seeks out another known survivor in pursuit of a lead.

9.t: The Battle of Gray Cat Town
9.o: Dali learns from Banri that Juras is in Gray Cat Town. Meanwhile, the members of Pendulum, who've taken the children hostage, find that they have their hands full looking after them.

10.o: Dali and his team uncover Pendulum's hideout and rescue Lord Johannes along with the children, but now Clara and Ul have been kidnapped...

11.o: Pendulum is after a teacher by the name of Krauss—TRUMP's alter ego. In order to prevent them from making contact, Dali and the team rush to the Clan.

12.o: As a dhampir, Juras doesn't have long left to live. In an attempt to kill TRUMP before he expires, he uses his cocoon phase power to enter the deity's mind.
